title: Complexity of computing the rotor-router action
exact_target: Determine how efficiently a specified sandpile-group element can act on a spanning tree by rotor routing.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3000015 (AMR-029-0015). CC BY 4.0.

M. Chan, T. Church and J. A. Grochow, Rotor-routing and spanning trees on planar graphs (2014), Section 2, Definitions and notation, pp.3--4.
